newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: One-mth Saudi t-bill flat, three and six mth fall.
newsitem.headline: One-mth Saudi t-bill flat, three and six mth fall.

text.p: The yield on one-month Saudi treasury bills was steady, while rates on three- and six-month bills were lower at this week's Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency offering worth three billion riyals, a banker said on Monday.

The yield on 28-day bills was unchanged at 5.3332 percent, while the rate on 91-day paper fell to 5.4598 from 5.5075 percent a week earlier. The yield on 182-day bills dropped to 5.5444 percent from 5.6669.
One-month interbank deposit rates were put at 5-1/2, 3/8 percent, three months were at 5-5/8, 1/2 percent and six months were at 5-11/16, 9/16 percent.
